title: Scoped export controls for saved audit queries with RBAC v2 enforcement
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Add scoped export controls and permission checks to the audit console saved-queries and export flows. Ensure exports (CSV/JSON/NDJSON) respect RBAC v2 role scoping, team-level sharing, and admin export quotas to reduce risk of data exfiltration. Provide a preview/redaction mode and sign export bundles for integrity verification.
acceptance_criteria: Saved queries can be created with an explicit visibility scope: private, team, or org-wide
Export UI only enables CSV/JSON download when viewer has an explicit export permission per RBAC v2 policies
Streaming exports use cursor-based pagination with a server-side enforced export rate limit and soft quota
Preview mode shows sampled rows with sensitive fields redacted when user lacks redaction_bypass role
All exports are HMAC-signed and include signed manifest metadata (query id, time range, author, role scope)
Audit trail records export downloads (who, when, query id, export format, bytes) and is queryable in the admin audit viewer
design_notes: Permission model: map existing RBAC v2 roles to three capabilities: query_view, query_run, query_export
Saved query visibility stored as metadata on saved_query object: visibility=private|team|org
Export flow will call new permission check endpoint (authz.export.check) that returns allowed_formats and soft_quota_remaining
Preview sampling should be deterministic (hash-based sampling by session id) to avoid exposing different rows across previews
HMAC signing key is rotated monthly; use KMS-backed key referenced by export signing service
implementation_notes: Backend: extend saved-query API to include visibility and owner_team fields
AuthZ: implement authz.export.check in Permissions service; reuse RBAC v2 policy engine rules
Export worker: add streaming exporter that enforces per-tenant soft quota and emits export events to audit-log topic
Frontend: update saved-query editor to surface visibility selector and export button state; add preview drawer with redaction legend
Metrics: add meters for export_attempts, export_bytes, export_sign_failures, export_quota_trips
rollout_plan: Feature gated behind ff-audit-export-scoped for initial 10% of orgs
Deploy backend changes behind db migration that adds saved_query.visibility field
Run a 48h canary in staging with synthetic export jobs to validate signature and quota enforcement
Gradually increase rollout to 100% with monitoring on export_attempts and error rate
qa_plan: Unit tests for permission matrix and visibility enforcement
Integration tests for streaming export with cursor pagination and quota enforcement
E2E tests: create saved query as user A, share team, verify user B with/without export permission can/cannot export
Security tests: verify HMAC signature on generated bundles and fail on tampered manifest
Performance test: verify export worker throughput for 10k row exports under normal and high concurrency
